Alex.day_scenario: Waking at 6:30 AM, Alex dives straight into early morning meetings before heading out the door, commuting to the office while listening to an industry audiobook. After a full day of coordinating deliverables and reviewing project timelines, they unwind with a quiet cup of tea before finally turning in at 11:00 PM.

Leo.day_scenario: Leo rises at 7:00 AM for a quick breakfast before packing his favorite wooden blocks for his morning preschool session. He spends the afternoon back in the living room, carefully stacking colorful towers that he deliberately leaves standing in the middle of the floor before his 8:00 PM bedtime routine begins.

Mia.day_scenario: Mia wakes at 7:00 AM and settles at the dining table, where she spends the morning sketching vibrant pictures with her wax crayons. After returning from preschool, she continues her craft project in the sunroom, leaving her scattered paper and crayons on the dining table before starting her 8:30 PM bedtime routine.
